evidence: The full-text article and the indexed v1.7 abstract are the same PMID and the same 426-exposure cohort. The source adds conditional results without duplicating the marginal clinical and Doppler counts.

The journal discussion at p. 1038 and reference 22 cite the 1991 SOAR study. Both describe historical JSC simulated EVA exposures. Counts and exposure thresholds differ and no participant crosswalk is published.

Test Procedures cites NASA TM-58259 as a source of the experimental profiles. Some Table II denominators and durations match the NASA archive. Exact profile membership and exposure linkage remain unavailable.
